description: This file defines the AdditionalSalary class and related functions for handling additional salary records in an ERP system, including validation, updates, and retrieval of additional salary data.

classes.name: AdditionalSalary
classes.description: Represents an additional salary record with methods for validation, submission, cancellation, and amount calculation.

methods.name: get_additional_salaries
methods.description: Fetches a list of additional salaries for a given employee and date range, filtered by component type, with handling for overwrite salary components.
